MASTER-OAGH robotic telescope  [1]  located in Mexico (OAGH National Institute for Astrophysics, Optics and Electronics) started inspect of the Fermi GRB 260516B ( Fermi GBM team, GCN 44636) errorbox  25 sec after notice time and 66 sec after trigger time at 2026-05-16 05:13:43 UT, with upper limit up to  20.0 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 33 deg. The sun  altitude  is -31.9 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = 62 deg., longitude l = 185 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3317801
